SASBDB entry SASDF42  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDF42/)

Publication: Identification of Binding Sites on Human Serum Albumin for Somapacitan, a Long-Acting Growth Hormone Derivative
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.biochem.0c00019

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDF42/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
